data.one_liner: A frosted blur bottom navigation bar with animated indicator and badge support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable floating or edge-to-edge bottom navigation bar featuring a blur/frosted glass effect, animated selection indicators, optional text labels, badges, and typed IconData or SVG icon support.
use_when: You want a modern floating bottom navigation bar with a blur effect.
Your application needs custom badges and animated indicators on navigation tabs.
avoid_when: You need standard platform-native bottom navigation bars (Material BottomNavigationBar or CupertinoTabBar).
strengths: Supports frosted glass blur via blurSigma.
Handles both IconData and SVG icons natively.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases.
Requires explicit scaffolding configuration (like extendBody: true) to render properly.
data.minimal_example:
CrystalNavigationBar(
  currentIndex: index,
  onTap: (i) => setState(() => index = i),
  items: [
    CrystalNavigationBarItem(
      icon: Icons.home,
      unselectedIcon: Icons.home_outlined,
      selectedColor: Colors.white,
      label: 'Home',
    ),
  ],
)
